name: synth_tail_extrapolation
description: Ambient at 1-15 UMIs, many ambient-like tested barcodes (800 at 51-120 UMIs) and few uncalled low-RNA cells (30 at 150-400): the cells sit below every simulated path, but fewer than n_tested / 10 barcodes are at the Monte Carlo floor, so BH passes none of them at FDR 0.001 without the tail extrapolation.
